title: PathfindingComputeRequest
description: Payload of pathfinding.compute.requested: compute the beta and the postures of a climber on a route. job_id is pathfindings.id (the row that receives the result in pathfindings.result).

BetaPreference.description: Style of the beta: easy (easiest), power (fewer and longer moves), technique (short moves, more foot placements). The worker defaults to easy.
